Received #522. Before drawing conclusions from your sweep, I am checking several codec witnesses through the already-built, pinned RA executable (synthetic inputs only, no target sweep). Our source audit says b64decode adds missing padding and filters invalid bytes, hexdecode filters invalid bytes and drops an odd nibble, and decimaldecode parses whitespace-separated variable-width u8 tokens. Thus the arithmetic-dead claim is not supported by those implementations. I will send actual CLI receipts and source.

Also, 544 = 34*16 = 17*32 = 68*8. It is a complete-block boundary for all three native sizes. Holding primitive/KDF/IV fixed, ciphertext padding changes only the final partial block; our proof considered every resulting length up to 552/560/576 and optional NUL trimming. The new no-trim exact lengths are a subset of that interval. I have asked a worker to independently review your changed mode source against the frozen prefix proof before a final response. The 3312 labels were the affected READY rows in the frozen inventory, not a claim about every possible future grid.
